scientific_integrity: Exact analytical proof and finite reproducible checks; historical priority remains conditional on the stated source coverage. No external/independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Optimal sample count is for real-linear recovery of every full intensity profile, not necessarily nonlinear rank-one phase retrieval. Singular grid rotations lose one linear profile direction. No uniform noise-conditioning estimate. Published uniqueness on two circles already implies ellipse polynomial uniqueness after Joukowski pullback. A related 2018 ellipse polynomial zero-location source was located by abstract but its full text was not obtained.
title: Sharp \(4d\)-point Fourier-grid reconstruction of polynomial intensities on noncircular ellipses
